Hero.badge: BORAMAE-RO, GWANAK-GU • KOREAN IZAKAYA & FUSION CUISINE
Hero.subtitle: A neighborhood izakaya in Gwanak-gu where fresh sashimi, charcoal-grilled skewers, and Korean spirits are served without fuss. Good food, fair prices, and a table always ready for you — solo, as a couple, or in a group.

Experience.title: Honest Food, Made with Care
Experience.paragraph1: HAJUNG (하정) was born from the pairing of Japanese culinary technique and Korean warmth. Set in a quiet alley of Gwanak-gu, we invite you into a cozy dining space filled with warm timber, soft lighting, and the gentle crackle of the grill.
Experience.paragraph2: We select fresh ingredients daily and prepare them by hand with no shortcuts — starting with our signature maguro yukhoe (seasoned raw tuna), a long-time favorite among our regulars. Good flavor isn't about expensive labels, but genuine care in the kitchen.
Experience.pillar1Desc: The chef cuts each piece by hand, with the same care for the first table of the night as for the last.
Experience.pillar2Desc: Our skewers are grilled over Korean oak binchotan charcoal, which lightly smokes without masking the ingredient's own flavor.
Experience.pillar3Desc: From the tableware to the presentation, we take care with every detail so each dish looks as good as it tastes.

Story.title: Quality. Warmth. Honest Prices.
Story.quote: «Good food doesn't need to be complicated. It just needs to be made with care.»
Story.desc1: HAJUNG is a neighborhood izakaya rooted in a simple belief: the best ingredients, prepared honestly, served with warmth. Nothing more, nothing less.
Story.val1: Every ingredient is hand-selected. Quality you can taste with every bite.
Story.val2: Solo, couple, or group — everyone is treated like a regular from day one.
Story.val3: Premium quality doesn't have to cost a fortune. We keep prices fair and honest.
Story.val4: A kitchen that runs with the discipline of professionals and the heart of a family.

chef.title: Precision at the Knife
chef.desc: Chef Koo Bonkwan cuts every piece of fish himself — with patience, precision, and a deep respect for the ingredient. His knife is an extension of his philosophy: no shortcuts, no compromises.

team.title: A Kitchen Built on Trust
team.desc: Behind every dish is a team that works in sync — quiet, focused, and proud of what they put on the plate. They cook like family because that's exactly what they are.

ambience.title: A Place to Stay a While
ambience.desc: Warm light, wooden tables, the sound of the kitchen — Hajung is designed to feel like a place you can return to again and again. Come alone or bring everyone.
ambience.tag3: Stay as long as you like
